digest.component_or_area: src/rebar/llm — model capabilities and structured output
propositions: native_structured_output is globally disabled for Claude by family default (_REBAR_OVERRIDES), but E1 measurement (df3a) demonstrated it works on specific Bedrock cells under extended thinking

the field native_output_with_thinking exists on ModelCapabilities but is omitted from three constructor sites (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback path, _intersect_capabilities), causing overrides setting it to True to silently default to False

_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES rows must enable native_structured_output and native_output_with_thinking for exactly the two measured cells (sonnet-4-6 adaptive thinking, haiku dated profile) and include measurement evidence (E1 account 896586841071 / us-east-1) and re-measure triggers
native_output_with_thinking must be plumbed through all three ModelCapabilities construction sites so capability overrides actually reach the constructed record and reach output_mode routing logic
FallbackModel chains must conservatively intersect native_output_with_thinking using all(...) so mixed chains collapse to False while all-supported chains preserve True

Bedrock opus-4-7/4-8 are explicitly non-rows for this capability (server-side rejection under thinking; re-measure trigger documented) and remain fail-closed to PromptedOutput despite carrying temperature rows
